psg.note: Pochettino 4-3-3 editorial. Neymar left, Messi right inside, Mbappé centre, Danilo and Verratti deep central partners, Wijnaldum additional CM. Official GK award to Donnarumma despite Navas more league starts.

marseille.note: Sampaoli tactical fluidity with back three and four. Inverted Rongier RB/CM, Luan Peres LB/LCB, Gerson advanced left interior/LM, Payet CAM/false nine, Ünder RW, Milik ST. Position classification for Gerson/Payet and Milik starter phase requires match-level review.

monaco.note: Kovač then Clément. Ben Yedder and Volland tandem, Tchouaméni/Fofana double pivot, Diop LW, Gelson RW; offensive wide rotation Golovin/Diop.

rennes.note: Génésio's 4-3-3 was used in 19 L1 matches by historical formation counts, with 4-4-2 in 13. Terrier LW, Bourigeaud RW, Laborde CF, Santamaría holding, Majer and Tait CM.

nice.note: Galtier frequently 4-4-2 with Gouiri and Delort forward two, Rosario/Lemina double pivot, Kluivert and Boudaoui in nominal wide midfield positions; Boudaoui actual LM/CM/RM mixed role, side frequency needs audit.

nantes.note: Kombouaré used 4-2-3-1 and defensive back-three alternatives. Blas right attacking/free CAM, Simon LW, Kolo Muani centre forward, Chirivella holding; Bukari 10-start right wing option and Cyprien-Moutoussamy CM rotation. FC Nantes is official 2021-22 original name (do not reuse obsolete FC Nantes Atlantique).
